settings.question: Do you ship to Nigeria?
settings.answer: Yes. Nigeria is one of {countries} countries we ship to. Your rate shows at checkout, before you pay. All countries

settings.question: What does shipping cost?
settings.answer: It depends on your address and shows at checkout. Canada ships free. You get an email when your order ships.

settings.question: How does sizing work?
settings.answer: Tops run true to size with a relaxed cut. Between sizes? Go up. Rings come in ring sizes. Size guide

settings.question: Returns and exchanges?
settings.answer: Contact us soon after delivery with your order number. Items must be unworn. Returns

settings.question: Which currency?
settings.answer: Prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD). Where possible you see your local currency and pay the amount shown.

settings.question: Will a sold-out piece come back?
settings.answer: Some do, some don't. Runs are small. Get drop alerts to hear first.

settings.question: How do gift cards work?
settings.answer: Choose {giftamounts} CAD on the gift card page. They pick the piece.

settings.question: Custom jersey?
settings.answer: Up to 10 characters. Message us with the details before you order.
